title: Wizardry Nemesis: The Wizardry Adventure
native_title: ウィザードリィ ネメシス
overview:
The Most Beautiful Challenge in Wizardry History

Immersive realistic backgrounds

Intense real-time battles

Top-class graphics and emotional full-motion movies depict the world of Nemesis

Nemesis is a single-character adventure set in the world of Wizardry. A dark force known as the Nithos Shadow has singled out a young man from the city of Galican, and you must journey through forests, castles and hidden ruins to learn why.

You explore in first person through pre-rendered 3D scenery, talking to the people you meet and solving puzzles by using the right items in the right places. When monsters appear, battles play out in real time: pick an attack or spell and target the enemy directly. Your weapon skills grow the more you use them, and you learn new spells as the adventure goes on. The game spans two discs and saves progress to backup memory.

ウィザードリィ史上最も美しい挑戦

吸いこまれるリアルバックグラウンド

迫力のリアルタイムバトル

最高峰グラフィックと情感あふれるフルムービーがネメシスの世界を描き出す
